```sql
SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('day', "CreaionDate") AS day,
    COUNT(*) AS daily_questions
FROM main."posts"
WHERE "PostTypeId" = 1
    AND "CreaionDate" >= DATE '2013-06-01'
    AND "CreaionDate" < DATE '2013-07-01'
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', "CreaionDate")
ORDER BY day
```
